text: Pump P-101 is vibrating hard at the drive end, reading 8.4 mm/s, with a grinding noise.
Idler roller on CV-401 is squealing loudly and the belt edge is fraying.
Smoke is coming from the terminal box of motor M-202, strong burning smell.
Compressor CC-301 discharge temperature is climbing and the machine is running too hot.
Oil is dripping from the output shaft of gearbox G-501.
P-102 shows vibration of 5.2 mm/s at the non-drive end.
Heat exchanger H-601 pressure drop is higher than normal and cooling is poor.
Motor M-201 keeps tripping on thermal overload every few minutes.
Mechanical seal on P-104 is leaking steadily, a puddle under the pump.
Gearbox G-502 is making a rattling noise under load.
CV-402 gearbox is whining and the oil sight glass looks low.
Pump P-103 vibration measured 12.5 mm/s, severe shaking of the base plate.
Fan motor M-203 is very hot to touch and smells like it is overheating.
Compressor CC-302 output is low and air pressure drop is visible at the receiver.
Fire in the control cabinet next to CC-301! Flames visible.
P-101 vibration of 7.5 mm/s at the drive end bearing housing.
Small oil leak at the shaft seal of H-601 circulation pump skid.
Belt on CV-401 is running off to one side and rubbing the frame.
P-102 pump vibrating with 8.9 millimetres per second at the bearing.
Gearbox G-501 sump is running hot, over 95 degrees.
There is a strange noise somewhere in the plant but I cannot tell where it comes from.
Motor M-202 trips its breaker when starting, short circuit suspected.
Compressor CC-301 vibration reading 4.8 mm/s, slightly up from last week.
Pump P-104 is running but flow is lower than usual and the gauge pressure has fallen.
